cases.question: What are good team tips for Lauma?
cases.answer: Lauma excels in Lunar-Bloom teams that include a Hydro character plus another Dendro or Hydro unit, and her Elemental Skill should stay on cooldown to keep generating Verdant Dew. [S1]

cases.question: How can I get free Primogems with redemption codes?
cases.answer: Free Primogem codes are announced during version livestreams and can be redeemed for Primogems (and Mora) [S1].

cases.question: How does Lunar-Charged work?
cases.answer:

Lunar‑Charged occurs when Electro meets Hydro (or vice versa) while a party member has a Moonsign Benediction passive, replacing the normal Electro‑Charged reaction. [S1][S2][S4]  
Triggering it creates a thundercloud that continuously deals Electro DMG to nearby enemies affected by both Hydro and Electro. [S1][S2]  
The cloud deals Electro DMG every 2 seconds to Wet opponents with Electro within 5 m, consuming 0.4 GU of both Wet and Electro auras simultaneously. [S3]  
If a target hasn’t taken Lunar‑Charged DMG in the last 2 seconds and is Wet or Electro, the cloud deals DMG immediately when the other aura is applied. [S3]  
Each thundercloud lasts 6 seconds; triggering another Lunar‑Charged reaction resets its duration, and only one cloud can exist at a time (a new reaction outside the cloud’s range replaces it). [S3]  
The DMG can crit and is based on all characters who applied elements during the reaction. [S2]  
Specific talents (Assemblage Hub Ineffa, Moonlight Lent Unto You Columbina, Old World Secrets Flins) convert Electro‑Charged to Lunar‑Charged and increase its base DMG according to ATK or Max HP, while also raising the party’s Moonsign level. [S5]
